# Page-7 underlines (lines 172-175) MUST be tagged as additions.
# Pre-fix bug: PyMuPDF's find_tables() falsely flagged the upper half of
# page 7 as a "table" because the parallel underline strokes looked like
# table borders.  The "no decoration tagging inside table zones" guard
# then suppressed ALL [A>…<A] tags for these four lines, silently
# stripping legislative additions from the output.
#
# Fix: _detect_table_zones() now excludes stroked horizontal lines that
# look like underlines (close below a text baseline + x-aligned with the
# text) from "table-border evidence" so the false zone is rejected.

[A>2. Perform ablation of the dermis or hypodermis.<A]
[A>3. Prescribe medication or provide medical treatment in the same manner as a<A]
[A>dermatologist.<A]
